articles.title: Assam Teacher Arrested After CCTV Allegedly Shows Brutal Assault on Primary School Students
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident has emerged from Assam’s Charaideo district, where a primary school teacher has been arrested after CCTV footage allegedly captured him brutally assaulting students inside a classroom.

body.html:
A shocking incident has emerged from Assam’s Charaideo district, where a primary school teacher has been arrested after CCTV footage allegedly captured him brutally assaulting students inside a classroom.

The incident was reported from Mathurapur Tea Estate Primary School, also known as Mathurapur Bagicha Primary School.

The accused has been identified as Md. Ariful Islam (51), a resident of Mathurapur Tiniali.

According to local sources, the matter came to light after the school headmaster reviewed CCTV footage installed inside the classroom. The visuals allegedly showed the teacher physically assaulting several minor students during school hours.

In one particularly disturbing scene, the teacher was reportedly seen attempting to throw a student out of a first-floor classroom window, sparking outrage among parents and residents.

Sources further alleged that students were also made to massage the teacher inside the classroom, adding to the seriousness of the accusations.

After clips from the CCTV footage surfaced on social media and triggered widespread anger, police detained the accused teacher and took him to the police station for legal procedures.

Authorities confirmed that the case is being treated seriously and that further investigation is underway.

Officials from the education department also stated that a separate departmental inquiry has been initiated. The Block Education Officer has reportedly been directed to conduct a detailed investigation into the matter.

According to reports, the school headmaster and the president of the School Management Committee jointly submitted a written complaint on May 5 to the Deputy Inspector of Schools of the Charaideo subdivision seeking strict action against the teacher.

The Assam Tea Tribes Students’ Association (ATTSA) also submitted a memorandum to district authorities demanding immediate and strong legal action.

The incident has sparked widespread concern over student safety inside educational institutions, with many parents demanding stricter monitoring systems in schools.

Social media users also reacted strongly, with several calling for severe punishment, psychological support for affected children, and better screening and accountability mechanisms for teaching staff.

Police said the CCTV footage forms a key part of the investigation, while both legal and departmental proceedings against the accused are currently underway.

articles.title: Youth Swept Nearly 50 Feet Into Air While Clinging to Tin Shed During Dust Storm in UP’s Bareilly
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A terrifying incident from Uttar Pradesh’s Bareilly district has gone viral after a youth was lifted high into the air while desperately clinging to a tin shed during a violent dust storm.

body.html:
A terrifying incident from Uttar Pradesh’s Bareilly district has gone viral after a youth was lifted high into the air while desperately clinging to a tin shed during a violent dust storm.

The incident took place on Tuesday evening in Bamiyana village under the Bhamora police station limits after strong winds struck the area during severe weather conditions.

According to villagers, the tin shed had been installed at a local marriage hall owned by Mohammad Shakir. As the storm intensified, several villagers initially tried to hold the iron structure in place to prevent it from being blown away.

However, as the winds became more violent, everyone except a youth identified as Nanhe ran to safety.

Nanhe allegedly continued holding onto the shed in an attempt to stop it from flying away.

Within moments, a powerful gust uprooted the entire structure and lifted both the shed and the youth into the air.

Shocking visuals now circulating on social media show Nanhe airborne while clinging to the flapping tin structure before being thrown into a nearby maize field.

Speaking after the incident, Nanhe reportedly said the storm carried him nearly 50 feet into the air. He suffered injuries to his hand and later complained of breathing difficulties.

Villagers immediately rushed to rescue him and shifted him to a nearby hospital.

Sources said he sustained multiple fractures in his arms and legs along with serious injuries to other parts of the body. He is currently undergoing treatment at a private hospital in Bareilly, where his condition remains critical.

Residents described the storm as extremely powerful, saying the shed was ripped apart and blown away “like a pack of cards” within seconds, leaving the village in shock.

Meanwhile, Uttar Pradesh Relief Commissioner Harikesh Bhaskar stated that at least 104 people have died across the state over the past 36 to 48 hours due to heavy rain, lightning strikes, and thunderstorms.

#Bareilly #UttarPradesh #DustStorm #Storm #ViralVideo

articles.title: Explosion During Air Gun Material Loading Triggers Panic in Solapur, CCTV Video Surfaces
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A sudden explosion in Maharashtra’s Solapur city triggered panic after a box containing material reportedly used in air gun cartridges accidentally fell while being loaded into a vehicle in the Juni Mill Compound area.

body.html:
A sudden explosion in Maharashtra’s Solapur city triggered panic after a box containing material reportedly used in air gun cartridges accidentally fell while being loaded into a vehicle in the Juni Mill Compound area.

According to police, the incident occurred when Kedarnath Kachare, an employee of Sahara Air Gun Shop, was loading boxes containing concentrated material related to air gun cartridges into the trunk of a car.

During the process, one of the boxes allegedly slipped and fell on his foot, immediately triggering a powerful explosion.

CCTV footage of the incident, now circulating on social media, shows a massive blast followed by thick white smoke spreading across the area, leaving nearby people shocked and frightened.

Locals rushed out after hearing the loud explosion, fearing a major accident.

Police teams reached the spot soon after receiving information and began an investigation into the incident.

Officials said the injured worker sustained injuries in the blast, while authorities are now examining the exact nature of the material involved and whether proper safety protocols were followed during storage and transportation.

Police are also verifying details related to the shop and the handling of air gun-related materials.

Further investigation is underway.

#Solapur #Maharashtra #Explosion #CCTV #AirGun #ViralVideo

articles.title: Thieves Attempt to Steal ₹1 Lakh From Bike Near Bethamangala Police Station, Locals Catch Accused
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking theft attempt was reported from Bethamangala in KGF taluk of Karnataka’s Kolar district, where thieves allegedly tried to steal ₹1 lakh kept inside a bike box near the Bethamangala Police Station.

body.html:
A shocking theft attempt was reported from Bethamangala in KGF taluk of Karnataka’s Kolar district, where thieves allegedly tried to steal ₹1 lakh kept inside a bike box near the Bethamangala Police Station.

According to reports, Ramesh, a resident of Bethamangala New Town, had withdrawn ₹1 lakh from a Canara Bank branch and kept the cash inside the storage box of his motorcycle.

Police said he had parked the bike near a shop and briefly stepped away when the accused, who were allegedly waiting for an opportunity, opened the bike box, stole the money, and attempted to flee.

However, Ramesh’s son reportedly noticed the theft and immediately raised an alarm.

Hearing the commotion, local residents chased the accused, caught them, and later handed them over to the police.

The entire incident was reportedly captured on CCTV cameras installed nearby.

The incident triggered anger among residents, especially because the alleged theft attempt took place close to the Bethamangala Police Station.

Some locals questioned the police response and alleged that officers did not react immediately despite the noise and commotion in the area.

Police have taken the accused into custody, and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Bengaluru Delivery Boy Robbed by Three-Member Gang in Indiranagar During Late-Night Delivery

articles.excerpt: A delivery boy was allegedly robbed by a three-member gang within the limits of Indiranagar Police Station in Bengaluru, raising fresh concerns over the safety of delivery workers and late-night commuters in the city.

body.html:
A delivery boy was allegedly robbed by a three-member gang within the limits of Indiranagar Police Station in Bengaluru, raising fresh concerns over the safety of delivery workers and late-night commuters in the city.

According to reports, the incident took place late at night while the victim, who works for a food delivery service, was carrying out deliveries in the area.

Police said the accused allegedly intercepted the delivery worker, threatened him, and snatched his mobile phone along with other belongings before fleeing from the spot.

The incident reportedly caused concern among local residents, many of whom questioned the safety of delivery personnel and commuters travelling during nighttime hours in Bengaluru.

After receiving information, police from Indiranagar Police Station reached the scene and conducted an inspection.

Authorities are currently analysing CCTV footage from nearby locations in an effort to identify and trace the accused involved in the robbery.

A case has been registered, and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Viral Video Sparks Outrage After MSRTC Driver Allegedly Assaults Passenger at Murbad Bus Depot
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident at Maharashtra’s Murbad bus depot has triggered outrage after a video showing an MSRTC bus driver allegedly assaulting a young passenger went viral on social media.

body.html:
A shocking incident at Maharashtra’s Murbad bus depot has triggered outrage after a video showing an MSRTC bus driver allegedly assaulting a young passenger went viral on social media.

Following widespread criticism, the Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation (MSRTC) administration has suspended the accused driver, identified as Dutta Bhalerao.

According to reports, the incident occurred when a young commuter approached the station controller at the Murbad bus stand to ask whether a bus to Kalyan was available.

What reportedly began as a routine inquiry soon escalated into a heated verbal argument between the passenger and the station controller.

During the altercation, MSRTC driver Dutta Bhalerao allegedly intervened and physically assaulted the young man in full public view.

Several passengers and commuters present at the depot witnessed the incident, while some recorded the confrontation on their mobile phones.

The video later surfaced on social media and quickly went viral, drawing sharp reactions from citizens and passengers who questioned the behaviour of public transport staff and the handling of commuters at bus depots.

After the footage gained attention online, MSRTC officials took note of the matter and initiated disciplinary action against the driver.

Authorities confirmed that Dutta Bhalerao has been suspended pending further inquiry into the incident.

The episode has once again raised concerns regarding passenger safety, staff conduct, and grievance handling at public transport facilities.

Officials are expected to conduct a detailed investigation into the incident, including examining witness statements and the viral video footage.

Further action may be taken based on the findings of the inquiry.

#Maharashtra #MSRTC #Murbad #ViralVideo #BreakingNews

articles.title: Man Stripped, Beaten and Smeared With Cow Dung Over Interfaith Relationship; 7 Booked
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident in Madhya Pradesh’s Bhopal has triggered outrage after a man from the minority community was allegedly assaulted, stripped, and humiliated in public by a group of people who accused him of being with a woman from another community at a hotel.

body.html:
A shocking incident in Madhya Pradesh’s Bhopal has triggered outrage after a man from the minority community was allegedly assaulted, stripped, and humiliated in public by a group of people who accused him of being with a woman from another community at a hotel.

The incident took place in the Govindpura police station area, and videos of the assault widely circulated on social media.

According to police, a group of people allegedly stormed into a hotel after receiving information that the 27-year-old man and a woman were staying there together. The group reportedly dragged the couple out of the room before assaulting the man on the street.

Viral videos showed the man being punched, kicked, partially stripped, and paraded in public while members of the crowd allegedly smeared black ink and cow dung on his face.

Police said the woman later informed investigators that she had been in a live-in relationship with the man for nearly five years and had gone to the hotel voluntarily. She reportedly denied allegations of coercion or misconduct and said she did not wish to file any complaint against him.

Officials further stated that the man had recently been released from jail and was facing multiple criminal cases in Bhopal, including allegations related to theft, fraud, and criminal breach of trust.

Govindpura police station in-charge Avdhesh Singh Tomar said the man was later arrested in connection with pending theft cases.

Following outrage over the viral videos, Bhopal Police registered an FIR against seven individuals allegedly involved in the assault and public humiliation.

Police said additional sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), including Sections 191(2) and 3(5), were added to the FIR registered under FIR No. 302/26.

According to police, the accused named in the case include Rohit Singh, Brijendra Prajapati, Jitu Kushwah, Ranjit Suryavanshi, and Lala Ram Meena. Officials also confirmed that one of the accused is a minor.

Bhopal Police Commissioner Sanjay Kumar said two accused have been arrested so far while further investigation is underway.

The incident has sparked widespread debate online over mob violence, vigilantism, and public humiliation in the name of social or religious identity.

#Bhopal #MadhyaPradesh #BreakingNews #MobViolence #ViralVideo

articles.title: CRPF Jawans Save Civilian After Cardiac Emergency on Jammu–Srinagar Highway
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Personnel of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) have earned widespread praise after rescuing a civilian who suffered a sudden cardiac emergency along the busy Jammu–Srinagar National Highway near Bijbehara in Jammu and Kashmir.

body.html:
Personnel of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) have earned widespread praise after rescuing a civilian who suffered a sudden cardiac emergency along the busy Jammu–Srinagar National Highway near Bijbehara in Jammu and Kashmir.

The incident occurred while jawans from the CRPF’s 90 Battalion were carrying out Route Opening Party (ROP) duties, a regular security deployment conducted to ensure safe movement along the strategically sensitive highway.

According to reports, the personnel noticed a man collapsing after experiencing severe medical distress during the operation.

Without waiting for medical teams to arrive, the CRPF jawans immediately rushed to assist him. Displaying quick thinking and presence of mind, they administered emergency first aid and worked to stabilise the man until professional medical help reached the spot.

Officials and local residents praised the personnel for their prompt humanitarian response, describing the act as an example of “service beyond duty.”

The incident has also drawn appreciation on social media, with many users commending the jawans for remaining calm and professional during the emergency.

One user wrote, “What impressed me most was how calm and professional they remained throughout the emergency. Training like this saves lives every day.”

Another commented, “Humanity at its finest. The quick response by CRPF reflects their exceptional training and compassion towards civilians.”

The CRPF, India’s largest paramilitary force under the Ministry of Home Affairs, is primarily deployed for counter-insurgency operations, convoy protection, and maintaining security in sensitive regions. However, personnel frequently assist civilians during medical emergencies, accidents, and natural disasters, especially in remote areas where immediate healthcare access may be limited.

The incident has renewed appreciation for the role played by security forces not only in maintaining law and order but also in saving civilian lives during emergencies.

#CRPF #JammuAndKashmir #Bijbehara #Humanity #BreakingNews

articles.title: Viral Hassan Gym CCTV Shows Brutal Assault After Minor Shoulder Bump, Youth Critical in ICU
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking CCTV video from a gym in Karnataka’s Hassan has gone viral on social media after a minor shoulder bump during a workout allegedly escalated into a violent assault that left a young man critically injured and battling for life in the ICU.

body.html:
A shocking CCTV video from a gym in Karnataka’s Hassan has gone viral on social media after a minor shoulder bump during a workout allegedly escalated into a violent assault that left a young man critically injured and battling for life in the ICU.

The incident reportedly took place at M.J. Fitness in Hassan in May 2025 (video is older but now it's going viral on social media).

According to reports, the victim, identified as Kirthan, was exercising inside the gym when he allegedly brushed shoulders with another man named Varun.

What initially appeared to be a minor accidental bump soon escalated into a heated argument. CCTV footage circulating online shows the two men exchanging words before the confrontation suddenly turned violent.

Within moments, Varun allegedly attacked Kirthan with a forceful blow to the head. Some social media users claimed it was a kick, while others described it as a punch or heavy strike.

The impact caused Kirthan to collapse instantly onto the gym floor.

The viral footage further shows panic inside the gym as other members rushed toward the spot. Some attempted to separate the individuals involved, while others gathered around the unconscious victim and tried to assist him.

The clip also reportedly contains disturbing medical visuals linked to the victim’s treatment, including 3D skull scans and CT scan images allegedly showing severe head trauma, brain swelling, and internal bleeding.

According to reports circulating online, Kirthan suffered a serious skull fracture and later slipped into a coma. He is currently undergoing treatment in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU).

#Karnataka #Hassan #GymFight #ViralVideo #BreakingNews

articles.title: Stray Dog Dies After Alleged Beating in Delhi’s Kirti Nagar; Animal Activist Booked for Assaulting G
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Delhi Police have registered two separate FIRs in connection with the alleged assault of a stray dog by a security guard in Kirti Nagar and the subsequent assault on the guard by an animal activist.

body.html:
Delhi Police have registered two separate FIRs in connection with the alleged assault of a stray dog by a security guard in Kirti Nagar and the subsequent assault on the guard by an animal activist.

According to police, a complaint was filed on May 8 by Tarun Ghai, a resident of Ramesh Nagar, alleging that security guard Vinod Paswan attacked a stray dog with an iron rod on the evening of May 7 in J Block, Kirti Nagar.

Police said the dog suffered severe injuries in the incident and later died during treatment.

During the enquiry, the complainant stated that the injured dog was initially taken to a private veterinary doctor and later shifted to Najafgarh for further treatment, where it eventually died.

Police further said that during the enquiry process, an animal activist identified as Jasmeet Kaur allegedly assaulted the guard outside the Kirti Nagar police station.

Vinod Paswan, a resident of JJ Colony in Inderpuri, also lodged a complaint regarding the alleged assault. His medical examination was conducted at Acharya Bhikshu Hospital on May 11.

Following a preliminary investigation, police registered FIR No. 104/26 dated May 11 against the guard under Section 325 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and Section 11 of the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act.

A second FIR, No. 105/26 dated May 11, was registered under Sections 115(1) and 126 of the BNS based on the guard’s complaint against Jasmeet Kaur and others.

Police said investigation into both cases is ongoing.

#Delhi #KirtiNagar #AnimalCruelty #DelhiPolice #StrayDog
